subject: Physics
axis_note: Owner-approved external-question-demand extension matrix; ladder_position orders this slice only and does not promote it into ordinary Grade-9 routing.

must_contain: A signed component vector in a declared basis.
Magnitude followed by retained-sign direction reasoning.
A normalized unit direction with a magnitude-one check.

controlled_variation.notice: magnitude can stay fixed while physical direction changes

controlled_variation.vary: angle from acute to right to obtuse
controlled_variation.notice: dot product changes positive to zero to negative

family.invariant_demand: Represent vectors in one basis, preserve sign and operand order, choose the correct scalar or axial operation, and verify with normalization, symmetry or perpendicularity.
family.difficult_move: Recognizing which representation/operation the question demands instead of treating every vector problem as component addition.
family.independent_check: Unit vectors have magnitude one; dot products are symmetric; cross products are perpendicular to both inputs and reverse under operand swap.

support_ladder.handed_over: Operation and basis are named and the relation is displayed.
Basis and requested geometric condition are supplied; learner chooses the operation.
Only vector statements and requested conclusion are supplied.

transfer.changed_demand: Signed components must become magnitude, direction and unit direction.
A question asks perpendicularity or projection without naming dot product.
transfer.information_not_handed_over: which scalar operation encodes the condition

transfer.changed_demand: A question requests a perpendicular axial direction or reverses cross-product order.
